mapper.select: SELECT CD.*, CI.CustName AS CustName FROM shopion.tPrfCustCpnDetail CD INNER JOIN shopion.tStrCustCpn C ON CD.CpnId = C.CpnId INNER JOIN shopion.tPrfCust CI ON CD.CustId = CI.CustId WHERE CD.State = 1 AND C.State = 1 AND CD.UseYn = 0 AND ( NOW() BETWEEN C.DiscntStartDate AND date_add(C.DiscntEndDate,interval+1 day) ) AND CI.ChnlCode = #{pChnlCode} AND CI.CustName LIKE CONCAT('%',#{pCustName},'%') AND CI.LoginId LIKE CONCAT('%',#{pLoginId},'%') AND CI.CustId = #{pCustId} ORDER BY CD.${sidx} ${sord}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shopion.tPrfCustCpnDetail CD INNER JOIN shopion.tStrCustCpn C ON CD.CpnId = C.CpnId INNER JOIN shopion.tPrfCust CI ON CD.CustId = CI.CustId WHERE CD.State = 1 AND C.State = 1 AND CD.UseYn = 0 AND ( NOW() BETWEEN C.DiscntStartDate AND date_add(C.DiscntEndDate,interval+1 day) ) AND CI.ChnlCode = #{pChnlCode} AND CI.CustName LIKE CONCAT('%',#{pCustName},'%') AND CI.LoginId LIKE CONCAT('%',#{pLoginId},'%') AND CI.CustId = #{pCustId}
